; C3X civilization trait effect profiles
;
; ==================================== IMPORTANT ====================================
; Do not edit this default file for personal or scenario changes: a C3X update may
; replace it. Put personal overrides in user.civilization_traits_config.txt in the
; C3X folder. Put scenario rules in scenario.civilization_traits_config.txt in the
; scenario search folder. Both files may contain only the #Trait blocks and fields
; they need to override.
; ===================================================================================
;
; OVERVIEW
;
; This file changes the gameplay effects attached to the eight original trait
; identities. Trait identity itself remains the Race.Bonuses bits stored in the
; BIQ. These profiles therefore do not reassign Civilopedia trait names, starting
; technologies, or the traits used to match Great Wonders for a Golden Age.
;
; C3X loads the profile files from lowest to highest priority:
;   1. default.civilization_traits_config.txt (this file, in the C3X folder)
;   2. scenario.civilization_traits_config.txt (in the scenario search folder)
;   3. user.civilization_traits_config.txt (in the C3X folder)
;
; A later file overrides fields set by earlier files. Scenario and user files are
; sparse overlays: omitted traits and omitted fields keep their previously loaded
; values. Each file is transactional. If a file contains an invalid value, unknown
; key, bad directive, duplicate field, or missing/unknown name, none of that file is
; applied; later valid files are still loaded.
;
; Every profile block begins with #Trait and requires name. Trait names and values
; in building_discount_tags use these stable, case-insensitive English tokens,
; independent of the game's language:
;   Militaristic, Commercial, Expansionist, Scientific,
;   Religious, Industrious, Agricultural, Seafaring
;
; NETWORK, SAVES, TIMING, AND DISPLAY
;
; Custom profiles are active only in non-network games. Network multiplayer uses
; the original executable effects because profile synchronization is not yet
; implemented. Local parse failures are written to the debugger instead of opening
; a modal error during network play.
;
; The external files are not copied into a saved game. New non-network saves store
; a deterministic schema/profile hash and warn once if the currently loaded files
; do not match it. Network saves omit this local-only hash; older saves without it
; continue to load normally.
;
; Starting scouts and coastal-start assignment occur once during new-game setup.
; Free era technologies occur on the next era transition. Changing those values is
; not retroactive: start a new game or wait for the next applicable event.
;
; The Civilopedia's built-in trait descriptions are not rewritten dynamically.
; Treat the loaded profile files as the authoritative description of custom effects.
;
; COMBINING MULTIPLE POSSESSED TRAITS
;
; Ordinary numeric bonuses add. promotion_chance_percent, anarchy_length_percent,
; and worker_rate_percent add their differences from 100, so two values of 150
; combine to 200. optimal_city_number_bonus_percent is different: 0 is neutral and
; the configured bonuses add directly. Boolean fields combine with OR.
;
; building_cost_percent participates only when its profile's discount tags match
; an improvement, and the lowest matching value wins. The lowest non-negative
; anarchy_fixed_turns and sinking chance wins; -1 does not enter those comparisons.
; A coastal-city commerce bonus is tested against its own profile's threshold before
; qualifying bonuses add. If multiple profiles request a coastal start, the lowest
; (least restrictive) threshold wins because satisfying any request is sufficient.
;
; TRAIT CONFIG FIELDS (each block begins with "#Trait")
;
; - name
;     Text (required). Stable English trait identity: Militaristic, Commercial,
;     Expansionist, Scientific, Religious, Industrious, Agricultural, or Seafaring.
;     Matching is case-insensitive; this is not a display name.
;
; - building_discount_tags
;     None or a comma-separated list of stable trait names. Selects the BIQ
;     improvement characteristics that receive building_cost_percent. Matching any
;     listed tag is sufficient. Great and Small Wonders are always excluded.
;
; - building_cost_percent
;     Integer from 0 to 10000: percent of normal shield cost for matching ordinary
;     improvements. 100 is normal and 50 is half cost. The normal minimum building
;     cost still applies. The lowest value among matching possessed profiles wins.
;
; - promotion_chance_percent
;     Integer from 0 to 10000: multiplier on normal post-combat promotion odds.
;     100 is normal; the original Militaristic value is 200.
;
; - optimal_city_number_bonus_percent
;     Integer from -100 to 10000: percent of the world-size base Optimal City Number
;     added to OCN. 0 is neutral; the original Commercial value is 25. This is an
;     additive bonus, not a multiplier whose neutral value is 100.
;
; - city_center_food_bonus
; - city_center_shield_bonus
; - city_center_commerce_bonus
;     Three comma-separated integers from -1000 to 1000, ordered town, city,
;     metropolis. These are additions to the city-center tile, not its final yields.
;     The original values are Agricultural food 1, 1, 1; Industrious shields
;     0, 0, 1; and Commercial commerce 0, 2, 3.
;
; - starting_scout_count
;     Integer from 0 to 100: number of Scout-line units granted by this profile at
;     new-game initialization. The original Expansionist value is 1. The game uses
;     the ruleset's default Scout or an available upgrade. Not retroactive.
;
; - goody_hut_table_bonus
;     Integer from -20 to 20: adjustment to the goody-hut result table. Positive
;     values move toward more favorable tables; the original Expansionist value is
;     1. The final table index is clamped to the nine tables in the executable.
;
; - goody_huts_never_barbarians
;     0/1 or false/true. If true, hostile-barbarian goody-hut results are rejected
;     and rerolled. The original Expansionist value is true.
;
; - goody_huts_allow_free_city
;     0/1 or false/true. If true, permits the free-city goody-hut result. The
;     original Expansionist value is true.
;
; - free_era_tech_count
;     Integer from 0 to 100: number of available technologies granted on entering
;     each new era. The original Scientific value is 1. This does not change BIQ
;     starting technologies and is not retroactive.
;
; - scientific_great_leader_chance_bonus_per_mille
;     Integer from -1000 to 1000: additive SGL chance bonus in thousandths. 1000 is
;     100%. The normal base is 30 (3%); the original Scientific bonus is 20, making
;     5%. The final chance is clamped from 0 to 1000.
;
; - anarchy_fixed_turns
;     Integer from -1 to 1000. -1 uses the normal random non-Religious formula.
;     The original Religious value is the engine's internal value 2, normally shown
;     as one turn of Anarchy. The lowest non-negative possessed value wins.
;
; - anarchy_length_percent
;     Integer from 0 to 10000: multiplier applied after the fixed or random Anarchy
;     length. 100 is unchanged. It also combines with anarchy_length_percent in
;     default.c3x_config.ini when that legacy option is not 100.
;
; - worker_rate_percent
;     Integer from 0 to 10000: multiplier on worker job strength. 100 is normal;
;     the original Industrious value is 150. Normal government, technology,
;     nationality, and unit worker-strength modifiers still apply.
;
; - irrigated_desert_food_bonus
;     Integer from -100 to 100: food added on tiles qualifying for the original
;     Agricultural irrigated-desert effect. The original value is 1. This field
;     does not make other terrain or non-irrigated desert qualify.
;
; - despotism_fresh_water_food_penalty_exception
;     0/1 or false/true. If true, a fresh-water city-center tile may keep food that
;     the government's standard tile penalty would otherwise remove. The original
;     Agricultural value is true. The no_penalty_exception_for_agri_fresh_water_city_tiles
;     option in default.c3x_config.ini can disable this exception globally.
;
; - sea_unit_move_bonus
;     Integer from -100 to 100: whole movement points added to sea-class units. The
;     original Seafaring value is 1. Normal movement scaling is handled by the game.
;
; - sea_sinking_chance_per_mille
; - ocean_sinking_chance_per_mille
;     Integer -1 or from 0 to 1000: sinking chance when ending a turn on Sea or
;     Ocean. 0 never sinks, 250 is 25%, and 1000 always sinks. -1 contributes no
;     override; with no profile override the original neutral chance is 500 (50%).
;     The original Seafaring value is 250 for both terrain types.
;
; - coastal_city_center_commerce_bonus
;     Integer from -100 to 100: city-center commerce added when an adjacent connected
;     water body meets this same profile's coastal_city_min_water_tiles. The original
;     Seafaring value is 1.
;
; - coastal_city_min_water_tiles
;     Integer from 0 to 1000000: minimum connected water-body size for this profile's
;     coastal-city commerce bonus. The original check is larger than 20 tiles,
;     represented here by 21.
;
; - prefer_coastal_start
;     0/1 or false/true. Requests a qualifying coastal starting location on a newly
;     generated map. Existing generated locations are reassigned; this does not
;     create a qualifying location. The original Seafaring value is true. Not
;     retroactive.
;
; - coastal_start_min_water_tiles
;     Integer from 0 to 1000000: minimum connected water-body size for this profile's
;     coastal-start preference. The original check is larger than 20 tiles,
;     represented here by 21.

#Trait
name                                                  = Militaristic
building_discount_tags                                = Militaristic
building_cost_percent                                 = 50
promotion_chance_percent                              = 200
optimal_city_number_bonus_percent                     = 0
city_center_food_bonus                                = 0, 0, 0
city_center_shield_bonus                              = 0, 0, 0
city_center_commerce_bonus                            = 0, 0, 0
starting_scout_count                                  = 0
goody_hut_table_bonus                                 = 0
goody_huts_never_barbarians                           = false
goody_huts_allow_free_city                            = false
free_era_tech_count                                   = 0
scientific_great_leader_chance_bonus_per_mille        = 0
anarchy_fixed_turns                                   = -1
anarchy_length_percent                                = 100
worker_rate_percent                                   = 100
irrigated_desert_food_bonus                           = 0
despotism_fresh_water_food_penalty_exception          = false
sea_unit_move_bonus                                   = 0
sea_sinking_chance_per_mille                          = -1
ocean_sinking_chance_per_mille                        = -1
coastal_city_center_commerce_bonus                    = 0
coastal_city_min_water_tiles                          = 21
prefer_coastal_start                                  = false
coastal_start_min_water_tiles                         = 21
